title: Ambush
text: I leveled up a bit after taking down the Pope and the Three Heroes Church members. As I walked out of the building carrying a wooden crate, Yuki-chan and the others came running over.
“Lord Motoyasu, are you hurt?”
“Is Kitamura okay?”
“Not a scratch on him.”
My level dropped a bit, but I’ll make that up in no time.
“More importantly, we managed to protect all the eggs!”
It would’ve been a hassle to have each member of the Three Heroes Church carry one. Well, if any of them had made a wrong move and broken one, I would’ve killed them on the spot.
“Wow… there are so many!”
“We got quite a lot, didn’t we?”
“If Filo-tan weren’t here, I’d leave the management to Yuki-chan.”
“I’ll take care of it.”
Last time, Yuki-chan acted as the representative and conducted the Cooperative Magic, after all.
“So, we’re heading straight to Lord Naofumi’s place now, right?”
“Going to Iwatani’s place?”
“I suppose so…”
“What!? The False Spear Hero!? Why are you still alive and here!?”
Just then, soldiers from the Three Heroes Church appeared before us, their faces frozen in shock.
“Nonsense! Wasn’t the plan to prepare for war only after confirming we’d taken down the False Spear Hero!?”
“Hahaha! The Pope was nothing but a pushover!”

At my reply, the soldiers fled as fast as they could. What’s more, the sentries who heard the commotion seem to be ringing a huge bell to signal an emergency. What a hassle. I’m not sure if even the Aiming Lancer will be enough to finish them off.

However, judging from that exchange, it seems the Trash haven’t given up yet. Hearing the bell, the revolutionaries must have sprung into action—there’s a huge commotion near the castle gates now… and smoke is starting to rise from the town below as well.

This… I have a hunch—though it’s just a feeling—that the Trash and the Crimson Swine who’ve been holed up inside are about to make their move. Father told me to hurry over… but I can’t let the Trash and the Crimson Swine get away. If I let them escape now, it’ll cast a shadow over the future Father desires. In that case…
“Kou, please take Filolial-sama’s egg.”
“Got it!”
I placed a wooden crate on Kou’s back and climbed onto Yuki-chan’s back.
“Yuki-chan. We’re going to make a little detour.”
“Where are we going, Motoyasu-sama?”
“That’s—the castle.”
I pointed toward Melromarc Castle.
――Beneath Melromarc Castle. Beyond the row of cells… lies the castle’s emergency escape passage. The sound of footsteps clattering on the cobblestone corridor echoes through the space.
“Boo!”

A group of men, clad in robes for stealth and accompanied by several subordinates, are hurrying through that escape passage. It’s clear that even Melromarc has secret passages and that they’re well-concealed. Their equipment makes it clear that the design prevents access to Melromarc’s underground waterways without specific mechanisms and keys.
“Bububuu!”
“H-ha! We’re in a hurry!”

One of his subordinates—who looks like a knight—is nodding at the Crimson Swine’s command and seems to be trying to disarm the mechanism ahead. He has the key. Just then—with a sharp thrust, I drove my spear straight into the Crimson Swine… breaking the concealment that had been hiding him.
“Oink—!?”
The Crimson Swine, startled by being impaled by my spear from his back to his chest and lifted off the ground, is about to turn around in surprise.
“Where do you think you’re going?”
“Wh—you fake Spear Hero! Why are you here!?”
“Princess Malty!”
One of his knights, apparently a subordinate, noticed the situation and shouted.
“Knowing this guy, I figured he’d try to escape the moment he realized he’d been defeated.”

Well, it was a long shot whether he’d still be in the castle, but I’d already analyzed that the only ones who’d propose a strategy like this were either Trash or the Crimson Swine. I suppose you could say I made it just in time.

I asked Yuki-chan to help me leap over the castle wall, while she was tasked with gathering intelligence at the Filolial Hall. From what I heard from Filolial-sama and the others, it seems Trash and Crimson Swine were planning to summon my Father after defeating me and set a trap for him. I’m also told that Itsuki’s allies are waiting inside this castle.

Well, at first glance, it probably looked like the threat was focused entirely on me. Since my Father is a shield, all he can do is defend. It’s true that he was overconfident—he even claimed he lacked the firepower for a one-on-one fight with Itsuki. I can imagine they were probably conspiring with the Three Heroes Church to devise this strategy.

After that, were they planning a rescue operation for Itsuki? It seems they intended to show my corpse to the Revolutionary Army to quell the uprising. To top it off, they planned to use their trump card—the replica weapons—to slaughter all the representatives… I learned all that by forcing a soldier we encountered along the way to confess. What a foolish bunch.

So, they tried to lure me into a despicable trap, but the Pope turned the tables on them. When that fact spread among the Revolutionary Army, the revolutionary movement reached its peak, and protests against the castle escalated to the point where they were trying to destroy the gates. It seems the Revolutionary Army is also searching for me to make me the figurehead of their revolution, but they’re too late for that.

Now that the Pope has fallen, the only one left in charge is the Wise King. Past glories have crumbled, and the Revolutionary Army knows that if they don’t quickly hand over the Wise King to secure peace with Siltvelt, the people might be slaughtered. That’s the situation, I suppose.

And as for the Crimson Swine, who’s been hiding behind those in power and doing as he pleases—it was easy to imagine that he’d realize he was completely out of a position and try to escape the castle… They were probably planning to seek asylum with Takt or something. So, I imagined how I would escape if I were the Crimson Swine.

From my previous playthrough, I know there’s a dungeon beneath Melromarc. It’s easy to guess what lies on the opposite side of the exit—based on the sound of water back then. I vaguely recall hearing somewhere that castles like this have emergency escape routes, so it was easy to imagine the Crimson Swine using this one.

Well, it wasn’t entirely impossible that he might have slipped away by blending in with the Revolutionary Army. But if he were going to choose such a chaotic situation, it was easy to imagine he’d take this route sooner rather than later.
“Where is the Trash? Ah, perhaps I should call him the ‘Wise King of Wisdom’ now.”
“Buh…”
“I didn’t ask for your response.”
The Crimson Swine’s face looks twisted beyond belief. Haha, this somehow puts me in a cheerful mood.
“Oh! The King is staying behind at the castle to let the Princess escape! You Spear Hero! Get away from the Princess at once!”
“Doing something like this… The Wise King of Wisdom will never forgive you!”
“Oh my, so even if you’re rotten to the core, you still want to sit on the throne, do you?”

That disgusting mindset—letting his daughter, the Crimson Swine, escape while clinging to the throne as king until the very end—it makes me want to vomit. I suppose the Crimson Swine must have started saying something about relying on someone who could resolve this situation. But that plan has failed, too. After all, he didn’t consider the fact that I’m standing right here like this.
“B-b-b-b—”

It seems the Crimson Swine is cursing under his breath, but I can’t make out a single word he’s saying. Is he calling me rude? Or is he saying there’s no way Daddy would ever forgive him? Or is he asking Takt to kill me?
“Hahaha, what on earth are you saying? I can’t make head or tail of it. Well then, I have just one thing to say to you.”
“Oink!?”
“Drop dead! Avenger of Fleon-chan!”
I pour my strength into my spear and cast my Skills.
“Burst Lance X!”
“Ooogggghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh―――……”
The spearhead exploded, and the Crimson Swine was blown to smithereens. Not a trace remained. Well, it sure was resilient, even after being impaled by a spear.
“T-The princess has been killed! Hurry, let’s report to the Wise King――”
“Brionac!”
“Whoa――”

I’ve blown away the accompanying knights along with the mechanism leading to the underground waterway. I’ve confirmed that the path leading to the waterway has completely collapsed. All that’s left is… to use fire magic to vaporize the filthy blood of the Crimson Swine left at my feet.

With this, I’ve successfully and discreetly eliminated one piece of trash from this world. There’s no benefit whatsoever in keeping this creature alive, and killing it won’t lead to war or become a stain on future generations. All that remains is the fact that the princess secretly fled and is now missing.
There are no witnesses whatsoever. I made them vanish like Smoked Meat. With this, the world will surely move toward a better future.
Fleon-chan… I’ve avenged you!
“Hahahahaha! Filth must be disinfected!”
